title: General George Stillhouse
specs: Falls of Rough was founded in the early 1800s and was home to various businesses, including gristmills, sawmills, and a tobacco warehouse.
One of the original owners of the area was George Washington.
Falls of Rough is home to Rough River State Resort Park, a vacation destination for the region.
